tipo.title: What do you need?
tipo.description: Choose jobs for individual Workday postings or companies for employer records from the full index. The Workday preset applies only to jobs. In company mode, country, technology, and keyword filters apply; job-only filters are ignored.

country.title: Country (ISO-2)
country.description: Jobs: filter Workday posting country. Companies: filter the country on the company record in the full employer index. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; empty means worldwide.

technology.title: Technology
technology.description: Jobs: exact match against extracted Workday technologies. Companies: filter the company-level aggregate in the full employer index, not a distinct-employers query over filtered jobs.

q.title: Keyword
q.description: Jobs: search Workday job titles and descriptions. Companies: search company names in the full employer index. Leave empty for no keyword filter.

seniority.title: Seniority
seniority.description: Return only Workday postings with the selected seniority. Leave empty to include all postings; not used in company mode.

remote.title: Workplace
remote.description: Return only Workday postings with the selected workplace type. Leave empty to include all postings; not used in company mode.

dal.title: Posted after
dal.description: Return Workday postings dated on or after this ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD), for example 2026-10-01. Posting dates may be estimated when the source has no exact date. Leave empty for no date filter; not used in company mode.

limite.title: Max results
limite.description: Maximum rows to return (1–10,000; default 100). You pay only for job or company rows returned: $0.002 per row ($2 per 1,000). An empty result costs $0.
